audit_result.proof_trace: The userinfo endpoint calls verifyAccessToken which correctly invokes jwt.verify with algorithms:['HS256'] and checks expiry; the null guard at route.ts:26-31 enforces the pre-condition. However, JWT_SECRET falls back to the hardcoded string 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' (oauth.ts:11) when the env var is unset — this value is publicly visible in the open-source repository, so any deployment missing the env var allows an attacker to forge tokens that pass signature verification.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker reads the public source, crafts an HS256 JWT signed with 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' containing arbitrary claims (any sub/discord_id), and sends it as a Bearer token to GET /oauth/userinfo; if JWT_SECRET is unset in production, verifyAccessToken returns a non-null payload and the endpoint returns the attacker-controlled member profile data.

PROP-stem-system-pre-009.text: OAuth userinfo endpoint must validate Bearer token JWT signature and expiry before returning data.
PROP-stem-system-pre-009.assertion: forall req: userinfo(req) => pre(jwt.verify(req.token, JWT_SECRET, {algorithms: ['HS256']}) != null)
